annotation.bound_parties_text: The part applies to all State, local, Tribal, and territorial (SLTT) law enforcement and correctional agencies and their personnel seeking to exercise or exercising C-UAS authority; contractors and others are also barred from circumventing it.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: This part applies to all SLTT law enforcement and correctional agencies, and their personnel seeking to exercise or exercising authority under 6 U.S.C. 124n(a)(2).
annotation.dates_quote: the authority of SLTT law enforcement and correctional agencies and their personnel under 6 U.S.C. 124n(a)(2) will terminate on December 31, 2031, as provided in 6 U.S.C. 124n(j)(2).
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Source: 91 FR 41498, July 6, 2026, unless otherwise noted.
